attributes.title: Acme Industries — Master Services Agreement 2026
attributes.terms:
## Term

One year from 15 July 2026, renewing annually unless either party gives 60 days' notice.

## Fees

USD 5,880 billed annually in advance. Late payment accrues 1.5% monthly.

## Scope

Workspace Pro for up to 50 seats. Additional seats billed pro rata at the then-current list price.
